title: Tenant key propagation breaks SAML role-mapping, causes audit log gaps — urgent patch
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Production customers on Private deployments (VPC and on-prem) started seeing intermittent RBAC failures and missing audit events after a scheduled tenant key rotation job. SAML assertions were accepted but role-mapping returned empty grants for affected tenants, and the audit service shows gaps for re-encrypt operations. This ticket tracks the urgent investigation, patch, and a minimally disruptive rollout for the private control plane and on-prem agent components.
steps_to_reproduce: Ensure tenant is on Private control plane with KMS-backed tenant encryption enabled (tenant uses envelope keys managed in customer KMS).
Trigger key rotation job (manual or scheduled) for tenant: run tenant-key-rotate --tenant-id <TID> --mode rewrap
Post-rotation, send an auth flow: perform SAML SSO for a user that maps to a role in the tenant's role mapping table.

Observe: SAML assertion accepted, but /authorize returns no roles; audit logs show missing 'tenant_key_rewrap' entry for some object IDs. Grafana shows spikes in 'auth.role_map.empty' and 'audit.flush_errors'.
mitigation: Immediate: temporarily disable automated tenant key rotation for private customers until patch is deployed (operator action documented below).
Short-term: run ad-hoc rewrap for affected tenants using the safe_rewrap tool that performs idempotent header validation: safe-rewrap --tenant <TID> --scan --repair
Customer comms: Notify impacted customers (Acme Health, BrightCommerce) with rollback steps and ETA for patch; offer dedicated run-by engineers for on-prem upgrades.
root_cause: The re-encryption (rewrap) code path used by the tenant rotation job did not update an auxiliary encryption header used by the on-disk role-mapping cache. Role-mapping objects remained encrypted under the old envelope header; the SAML attribute deserializer checks header metadata and rejects objects with mismatched header version, causing role-mapping to return empty grants. Separately, the audit-writer batching logic drops 'rewrap' event entries when an earlier rewrap failed with a transient KMS Throttling response; those dropped events created an apparent audit gap.
proposed_fix: Patch rotation worker to atomically update the role-mapping header during rewrap and add a compatibility path to read old-header objects for 48 hours post-rotation (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2742).

Make audit-writer resilient: add retry on KMS Throttling and log to dead-letter queue (DLQ) instead of dropping; DLQ consumer will surface failures to PagerDuty. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/893).
Add a migration job 'rolemap-header-sync' that runs in parallel and reconciles any objects missed by the rotation job with idempotent writes and exponential backoff.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge PRs and run unit + integration tests in staging with private mode enabled (end-to-end SAML flows).
2) Canary deploy patched rotation worker in non-prod private tenant and run continuous SAML role-mapping tests for 24h.
3) Deploy audit-writer fixes to observability cluster and enable DLQ monitoring.
4) Schedule a phased deploy for private control plane: 10% tenants -> 50% -> all, with a 1-hour observation window between phases.
5) For on-prem customers, ship a 1.0.3 agent hotpatch and offer assisted upgrade; coordinate maintenance windows with customers.
verification_criteria: SAML role-mapping returns expected roles for a 100-sample of users across 10 canary tenants after rotation is simulated.
No new 'auth.role_map.empty' alerts for 48 hours post-rollout in production for patched tenants.
Audit writer DLQ receives zero new 'rewrap' drops and all previous DLQ entries are reconciled within 24 hours.
Safe-rewrap tool reports zero unrecoverable objects after running against affected tenants.
